USD models are converted to CNY at the reference rate for comparison (see summary). Costs within display precision are marked tied; neither side is favored.

Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: Claude Haiku 5.5 ¥11.00 vs Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite ¥31.54 on a common CNY basis (list prices $1.64 / $4.69) — at this fixed usage, Claude Haiku 5.5 is cheaper by ¥20.54/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite costs about 2.9× Claude Haiku 5.5 (Claude Haiku 5.5 is ~65% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $0.1 vs $0.25; after conversion Claude Haiku 5.5 is lower (by ≈ ¥1.01/1M tokens).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $0.5 vs $1.5; after conversion Claude Haiku 5.5 is lower (by ≈ ¥6.72/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): Claude Haiku 5.5 $0.01; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite $0.025.
  • Context window: identical at 1024K.
  • Modalities: Claude Haiku 5.5=Text, Image understanding; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite=Text, Image understanding, Video understanding (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite adds Video understanding).
  • Price sources: Anthropic official pricing (verified 2026-10-28), Google AI pricing (verified 2026-10-28); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (Claude Haiku 5.5 in USD, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite in USD).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
